node.statement: Because delta>0, tau=sqrt(delta)>0 and tau/4>=0, and also 2+4*delta>0. The row negative mass nu_v is a sum of terms max(-P_vj,0), so nu_v>=0. Together with sigma-sigma_g>=0 from the preceding child, both (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4 and nu_v*(2+4*delta) are nonnegative, and therefore their sum, the right hand side, is nonnegative.
